operator_message_verbatim.text:
Proceed with the following round-1 dispositions.

A1 — FIX

Fix all four affected SY1 fixtures:

- "A4-SYNTH-R1-01"
- "B4-SYNTH-R1-02"
- "B4-SYNTH-R2-15"
- "B4-SYNTH-R3-08"

Apply the same semantic role-label correction already used for the eight previously repaired SY1 fixtures.

Do not replace these fixtures.

The correction should be minimal and should change only the defective "diagnosis" / finding-cause role labeling. Preserve the fixture's intended reasoning, answer, difficulty and all unrelated content.

For the A′ fixture, follow the frozen A′ re-adjudication procedure with 3 adjudicators. For the B′ fixtures, follow the frozen B′ remediation/re-adjudication procedure.

A2 — FIX

Fix "B4-CONV-R1-08".

Make the dispatch timing unambiguous so that the intended qualifying option is uniquely derivable.

Use a minimal wording change. Preserve the intended answer and all unrelated fixture content.

Then run the frozen B′ re-adjudication procedure.

Do not use reserve "B4-CONV-R1-X08" unless the repaired fixture subsequently fails the frozen remediation procedure.

A3 — FIX

Fix "B4-CONV-R2-28".

Remove the inclusive/exclusive day-count ambiguity. Prefer explicitly establishing the relevant end date rather than introducing a broader counting convention unless the frozen fixture structure requires otherwise.

Use a minimal wording change and preserve the intended answer and unrelated content.

Then run the frozen B′ re-adjudication procedure.

Do not use reserve "B4-CONV-R2-X04" unless the repaired fixture subsequently fails the frozen remediation procedure.

Authorization

I authorize the new adjudicator sessions required solely for the A1, A2 and A3 remediation above.

Use the existing frozen O2 adjudication procedure and configuration applicable to each corpus.

Do not alter:

- gold except through an independently triggered frozen escalation path;
- adjudication rules;
- thresholds;
- validator behavior;
- fixture-selection rules;
- independence measures;
- success criteria.

Record the new sessions as remediation sessions with complete provenance and bind them to the exact pre-adjudication repaired fixtures.

Do not reinterpret previous adjudication results.

A4-PLAN-R3-04

Disposition: KEEP WITH DISCLOSURE.

Do not modify the fixture or gold.

The three adjudicator refusals are retained as a disclosed limitation of its historical adjudication. Reviewer A independently derived the reference answer and matched gold, and neither reviewer identified a derivability defect.

The refusals alone do not justify a fixture or gold change.

Reviewer A note A4

Record as a disclosure.

State that the A′ corpus does not exercise research P4 in the case where reposts are the only support, while B′ does.

Treat this as a documented coverage limitation. Do not add or modify fixtures during this review solely to eliminate it.

Reviewer A note A5

Record as a disclosure.

State that synthesis families SY4–SY6 have a constant conclusion within each family.

Treat this as corpus-structure information relevant to interpretation of results, not as an automatic defect or authorization to modify the corpus.

Reviewer A note A10

Issue a second erratum for "B_MAIN_CLOSURE.json".

Do not edit the closed file.

The erratum should state that the closure's reference to "14 reserves" is incorrect and that the correct count is "15 reserves".

Bind the erratum to the unchanged closure artifact by digest and derive the correct reserve count mechanically from the bound records.

After the A1–A3 repairs are made, preserve exact before/after fixture text and digests before any adjudicator call.

After re-adjudication, apply the frozen remediation disposition rules exactly as written. If any repaired fixture fails in a way requiring replacement, stop and return that case to me before replacing it unless the already-frozen procedure explicitly makes replacement automatic.

Once A1–A3 are resolved, regenerate every downstream artifact whose inputs changed, including the applicable closure reports, independence checks, fix checks and external-review reconciliation.

Do not modify sealed historical artifacts. Bind corrections, remediation records and regenerated downstream outputs through provenance instead.

Round 1 may close only after the repaired fixtures have completed re-adjudication, all MUST-FIX findings are resolved, the new disclosures/erratum are recorded, and the final independence re-check reproduces the required frozen values.

A1.procedure: the recorded SY1 role relabel; A′: three adjudicators (kept only if all three agree, otherwise the operator); B′: the frozen B′ procedure

A2.procedure: frozen B′ procedure; reserve B4-CONV-R1-X08 only if the repaired fixture fails the frozen remediation procedure

A3.procedure: frozen B′ procedure; reserve B4-CONV-R2-X04 only if the repaired fixture fails the frozen remediation procedure
A3.wording_note: the operator preferred stating the end date explicitly unless the frozen fixture structure requires otherwise. It does: the CV2 depth-1 construct binds the start date and the duration as facts and computes start + days against the deadline (the checker requires exactly those facts); a stated end date would pre-evaluate that computation. The fix therefore defines the end relative to the start ('finishes ... N days later'), which fixes the end date by addition, without a counting convention.

A4-PLAN-R3-04.source: Reviewer B B5 / Reviewer A A7
A4-PLAN-R3-04.disclosure: The three adjudicator refusals are retained as a disclosed limitation of its historical adjudication. Reviewer A independently derived the reference answer and matched gold, and neither reviewer identified a derivability defect. The refusals alone do not justify a fixture or gold change.

A4.disclosure: The A′ corpus does not exercise research P4 in the case where reposts are the only support, while B′ does (B4-RSRCH-R1-12, B4-RSRCH-R2-12, B4-RSRCH-R3-12). No fixture is added or modified to eliminate it.

A5.disclosure: Synthesis families SY4, SY5 and SY6 have a constant conclusion within each family (decision_reserved, constraint_breached and behavior_by_design respectively). This is not a defect and does not authorize a corpus change.

authorization: remediation adjudicator sessions for A1-A3 only, under the existing frozen O2 procedure and amended configuration 7691126e…; recorded as remediation sessions, bound to the committed pre-adjudication fixed fixtures (the run journal binds the fix record digests)
